jobs_results.description:
As a Robotics Software Engineer on the Isaac Applications Team, you will bring together the software and hardware that enable Physical AI robots to operate in the real world. You will build working robotic systems and end-to-end workflows for engineers and AI agents. These workflows connect data, simulation, and real-world deployment to continuously expand and improve robot capabilities.

  


We’re looking for strong software engineering skills, broad robotics knowledge, and enthusiasm for working hands-on with physical robots when taking ideas into practice. You enjoy understanding how components interact, solving problems across their boundaries, and seeing them come together to deliver new robot capabilities.

  


## What you will be doing:

  * Lead the forefront of Physical AI progress in both simulated and real humanoid robots by building the humanoid reference platform that features NVIDIA's robotics technologies.
  * Build end-to-end workflows to develop, evaluate, and deploy increasingly autonomous and interactive robot capabilities.
  * Extend our platform to new robot embodiments and demonstrate its adaptability through hands-on integration and validation. Address real-world compute, latency, and bandwidth constraints on physical hardware.
  * Collaborate across teams in Shanghai, America, and Europe to connect capabilities and deliver reliable robotic systems.

  


## What we need to see:

  * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  * 8+ years of relevant industry experience working on robotics software.
  * Hands-on experience integrating, deploying, and testing software on physical robots, and confidence working directly with hardware when needed.
  * Experience deploying and evaluating learned policies to control physical robots.
  * Broad working knowledge of robotics software, hardware, AI, and agentic systems. We value an understanding of how these components interact within a complete system.
  * Strong problem-solving skills, including tracing issues across software and hardware boundaries. Ability to work independently through ambiguous technical challenges.
  * Interest in designing robotics interfaces for agent-driven operation, with the ability to learn and evaluate new approaches.

  


## Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  * Experience integrating humanoid robots or mobile manipulators, from initial bring-up through reliable demonstrations of robot capabilities.
  * Experience diagnosing and resolving system-level challenges across robotics software and hardware.
  * Experience building end-to-end robotics workflows where AI agents perform substantial portions of the work and guide engineers through data collection, training, evaluation, and deployment.



Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 20, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs_results.description:
About Lucid


At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 


We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

 






Position Overview




The Powertrain Robotics Engineer, supports robot commissioning, programming, recovery, and tooling integration across AMP-2 Powertrain robotic cells. Joining at facility launch, this engineer supports FANUC, ABB, and KUKA cells from first commissioning through volume ramp. The role is a hands-on contributor to robot uptime, cycle time, and safety compliance.






 






Key Responsibilities


 




1.               Robot Integration, Commissioning, Teaching & Programming for FANUC, ABB, and KUKA


2.               Support offline programming and simulation activities


3.               Maintain and optimize the robots to maximize the throughput throughout the life-cycle of the asset.


Robot Recovery & Troubleshooting


4.               Diagnose robot faults: encoder, drive, cables, controller, program issues, etc


5.               Support production recovery events including robot resynchronization and program restoration


6.               Conduct structured RCA for repeating robot failures


Tooling (EOAT) Integration


7.               Support end-of-arm tooling design reviews, integration, and change management


8.               Troubleshoot EOAT issues etc


Robot Safety Support


9.               Support robot safety validation activities


10.             Ensure safety configurations, light curtains, and interlocks are maintained and validated


HV Safety & Compliance


11.             Enforce HV LOTO, HVIL continuity, and mandatory HV PPE for all work on or near EV Powertrain equipment


12.             Comply with SASO, IEC 60204, and functional safety standards (ISO 13849 / IEC 62061)


13.             Support HV emergency response including thermal runaway isolation and battery-related incident procedures


14.             Achieve and maintain HV safety competency appropriate to scope of work


 


Launch Governance & Ramp-Up


15.             Support AMP-2 Safe Launch activities, run-at-rate events, and capacity verification within scope


16.             Contribute to Launch Readiness Reviews, Layered Process Audits, and Process Confirmation routines


17.             Participate in QRQC / RCCA escalations during launch and ramp-up phases


Robot Application Engineering & Validation


18.             Develop maintainable robot programs, frames, TCPs, payload data, zones, mastering, backups and recovery standards; validate path accuracy and cycle repeatability.


19.             Integrate EOAT, vision, conveyors, safety PLC handshakes, process equipment and MES/traceability signals; confirm failure-mode recovery and restart behavior.


20.             Execute reach, collision, singularity and cycle-time studies using RoboGuide, RobotStudio or KUKA.Sim and verify results on equipment.


21.             Maintain controlled robot/EOAT backups, revision history, spare strategy and preventive-maintenance inputs.


Launch Governance, Change Control & Operational Readiness


22.             Support FAT/SAT, commissioning, equipment acceptance, Safe Launch, run-at-rate and capacity verification with objective evidence and disciplined punch-list closure.


23.             Control production, process, software and test changes through documented risk assessment, approvals, validation, revision history and rollback or containment planning.


24.             Participate in readiness reviews, Layered Process Audits, Process Confirmation and QRQC/RCCA; close assigned actions with verified effectiveness.


Safety, Quality, Data Integrity & Compliance


25.             Apply role-specific HV LOTO/HVIL, machine safety, stored-energy isolation, electrical safe-work and PPE requirements; never bypass safety devices or product protections.


26.             Protect product genealogy, calibrated-tool status, test/measurement integrity, document control and audit-ready objective evidence.


27.             Comply with applicable AMP-2, SASO, Saudi labor/EHS, IATF 16949, IEC 60204 and functional-safety requirements within assigned scope.


Saudization, Capability Transfer & Collaboration


28.             Build Saudi national capability through structured OJT, skills matrices, practical assessment, certification, cross-training and documented knowledge transfer.


29.             Create technical standards, troubleshooting guides and training material


30.           Collaborate across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Automation/Robotics, Manufacturing Engineering, EHS, IT/OT, MES, Supply Chain, Product Engineering and suppliers.






 






Skills




31.             Strong hands-on robotics programming skills (FANUC, ABB, etc)


32.             Working knowledge of robot safety standards


33.             Structured troubleshooting mindset


34.             Effective communicator in bilingual (English/Arabic) technical environments


35.             Technical standards, structured problem solving, risk-based decision making and controlled documentation


36.             Data literacy: KPI definition, trend analysis, evidence-based validation and clear executive/shop-floor communication


37.             Cross-functional influence, supplier coordination and disciplined ownership in a greenfield launch environment


38.           Coaching, competency assessment and knowledge transfer in a multicultural English/Arabic workplace






 






Minimum Qualifications


 




39.             Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering


40.             3+ years in industrial robotics


41.             Hands-on programming experience with FANUC, ABB, or KUKA


42.             Fluent in English; Arabic strongly preferred


43.             Preferred: multi-brand robotics experience; EOAT integration; greenfield launch experience


 


Preferred Qualifications


44.             Demonstrated experience with commissioning, FAT/SAT, launch, production readiness or high-volume manufacturing ramp within the role discipline


45.             Working knowledge of IATF 16949, APQP/change control, machine/HV safety and traceability requirements applicable to the role


46.           Lean/Six Sigma, greenfield EV/automotive launch and workforce-development experience

I. About the Role

VinDynamics is developing next-generation humanoid robots capable of performing complex tasks in home and office environments.

We are seeking talented AI Robot Engineers specializing in Whole-Body Manipulation to join our team to develop and deploy AI models that enable humanoid robots to coordinate locomotion, balance, and manipulation to perform real-world tasks.




II. Key Responsibilities

Whole-Body Manipulation: Develop learning-based policies that coordinate the hands, arms, and whole body for reaching, grasping, lifting, carrying, and other contact-rich manipulation tasks.Robot Learning: Apply reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning (IL), vision-language-action (VLA) models, World Action Models (WAM), and motion tracking to develop robust humanoid manipulation and loco-manipulation skills.Simulation & Training: Build scalable training pipelines using Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or similar simulators, including reward design, curriculum learning, and domain randomization.Human Motion Learning: Leverage human motion-capture data, teleoperation, demonstrations, and egocentric data for motion retargeting, imitation learning, and policy improvement.Sim-to-Real Deployment: Transfer trained policies to physical humanoid robots, optimize real-time inference, and improve robustness and task success rates in real-world environments.System Integration: Integrate AI models with whole-body controllers, motion planners, perception systems, and vision-language-action (VLA) models.


III. Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications 

Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Control Engineering, or related fields.2+ years of experience applying multimodal data to train AI models for robotic manipulation.Strong understanding of data types and data requirements to train AI models for whole-body manipulation.Strong understanding of reinforcement learning, imitation learning, VLA models, diffusion-based methods, World Action Model (WAM),Solid understanding of robot kinematics and dynamics, and feedback control.Strong programming skills in Python, C++, and PyTorch.Hands-on experience with robotic simulation platforms such as Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo.Experience developing and training policies for robot manipulation, locomotion, or whole-body control.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to design, evaluate, and debug robotic learning systems.Preferred Qualifications 

Experience deploying learning-based policies on physical humanoid, quadruped, or robotic manipulation platforms.Familiarity with PPO, actor-critic methods, imitation learning, motion tracking, and sim-to-real transfer.Experience with human motion retargeting, teleoperation data collection, and large-scale robot learning pipelines.Experience deploying AI models on real robots, including optimization for real-time inference.Experience with bimanual manipulation, dexterous hands, and contact-rich manipulation tasks.Familiarity with ROS 2, VLA models, diffusion policies, or robotics foundation models.Publications or open-source contributions in robotics, robot learning, or embodied AI are a plus.


IV. What You Will Build

Whole-Body Reaching: Humanoid robots that bend, squat, step, and reach to manipulate objects.Loco-Manipulation: Robots that walk while grasping, lifting, and carrying objects.Bimanual Manipulation: Coordinated two-arm manipulation with balance-aware control.Real-World Autonomy: Robust whole-body skills integrated with perception and high-level task planning.
